36:41.text: for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship

36:42.text: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride.

36:43.text: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout

36:44.text: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.

36:45.text: And when it is said to them: "Fear of that which is before you
, and that which is behind you
, in order that you may receive Mercy
(i.e. if you believe in Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism, and avoid polytheism, and obey Allâh with righteous deeds)

36:46.text: And never came an Ayâh from among the Ayât
(proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.)
of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.

36:47.text: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allâh has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allâh willed, He
would have fed? You are only in a plain error."

36:48.text: And they say: "When will this promise
be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"

36:49.text: They await only but a single Saihah
, which will seize them while they are disputing!

36:50.text: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.

36:51.text: And the Trumpet will be blown
and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.

36:52.text: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep."
had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"

36:53.text: It will be but a single Saihah
, so behold they will all be brought up before Us!

36:54.text: , none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.
